# Provenance: `frame-views-floorplanned` golden case

## Design + HLS inputs

`design.json` and `inputs/*.v` are byte copies of the `frame-views` case
(see that case's `PROVENANCE.md`). As in `vadd-floorplanned`, the harness
flattens the graph before codegen when a `floorplan.json` is present, so
the generated top names streams in their flattened form
(`rows_CornerTurn`, `cols_Drain_0_CornerTurn`, ...).

## Floorplan: produced by the real planner

`floorplan.json` is the verbatim, pretty-printed output of
`tapa_floorplan::plan_with_inputs` on this design, regenerated by the
ignored probe test, which plans both floorplanned cases:

```sh
cd tapa-core && cargo test -p tapa-floorplan \
  --test golden_floorplan_probe -- --ignored --nocapture
```

Inputs (`tapa-floorplan/tests/common/mod.rs`, `FRAME_VIEWS`): device
`u280` with the `vadd-floorplanned` case's platform and solver settings;
the two direct M-AXI endpoints bound as a user would in `--connectivity`,
`src -> HBM[0]` (`Load_0`) and `dst -> HBM[16]` (`Store_0`), the banks of
that case's `a` and `b`; the top's `s_axi_control` slave.

The chosen plan places `Load_0` in `SLOT_X0Y0` and `Store_0` in
`SLOT_X1Y0`, each with its bank, and `Turn_0`, `TurnOut_0`, `TurnIn_0`,
the controllers and `control_s_axi_U` in `SLOT_X1Y1`. Two frame channels
cross slots: `rows_CornerTurn` (an element stream into `Turn_0`'s frame
port, 2 hops) and `cols_Drain_0_CornerTurn` (`TurnIn_0`'s frame port into
an element stream, 1 hop). `once_CornerTurn`, between two frame ports,
stays in one slot. The regions name the frame-port half of each split
channel, `rows_CornerTurn_recv` and `cols_Drain_0_CornerTurn_send`, with
its frame port; a channel in one slot has no halves.

## Blessed output

Same rules as the other cases; the floorplanned top has distributed
control and no `CornerTurn_fsm.v`. This case exercises a frame channel
copied across slots: a crossing stream whose frame-port end gets its half
of the channel (`frame_channel`, `W_VIEW = 1, R_VIEW = 0` for `_send`,
`W_VIEW = 0, R_VIEW = 1` for `_recv`, the channel's banks), whose element
side is joined to the stream's own `{stream}_fifo` pipeline (a
`tapa_hs_pipeline` of the element and end-of-transmission bits, `DEPTH`
2, `BODY_LEVEL` from the route), and whose element-stream end binds that
pipeline directly; next to the shared channel `once_CornerTurn_fifo`.
